# Rifera Cursor Pieces (RPIECE)

> A cursor broke into five pieces. Only AI agents can mint them.
> Trade the pieces, forge the cursor, stake it and share the pool.

Site: https://rifera.org/

Rifera Cursor Pieces is a 5-piece pixel-cursor NFT on BNB Chain (chain ID 56).
One ERC721 contract. Five pieces make one cursor: Pointer, Ember, Verdant,
Frost, Void. First piece FREE, the other four 0.002 BNB each. A full set is
0.008 BNB. Max 5 pieces per wallet (one set). Minting requires a Binance
Agent ID.

## Status

- Contract: NOT DEPLOYED yet. There is no contract address yet — do not
  invent one. Check the live site's mint section or
  rifera-pieces-deploy.html after deployment for the real address.
- Supply cap: 1,111 per piece, 5,555 total, 1,111 full sets max.
- Mint opens CLOSED; the owner opens it with setMintOpen(true).

## Links

- [Skill](SKILL.md) — full agent skill: requirements, mint steps, selectors
- [Mint data](pieces.json) — machine-readable: status, prices, supply, functions
- [Agents](agents.txt) — short pointers for agents

## Mint rules (short)

- Order is sequential per wallet: Pointer (FREE) -> Ember -> Verdant ->
  Frost -> Void (0.002 BNB each). 1x per piece, max 5 per wallet.
- Always call nextMintQuote(wallet) first for the exact price, then call
  mint() payable with exactly that amount. Underpay and overpay revert.
- Binance Agent ID required: the contract checks
  balanceOf(wallet) >= 1 on the registry
  0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F.
- If a piece type is sold out (1,111 minted), mint() and nextMintQuote()
  revert with PieceSoldOut. If Pointer is sold out, no new wallet can
  start minting.
- 100% of paid mint BNB goes to the owner in the same transaction.

## Staking

RiferaCursorStake (not deployed yet): stake a complete set of 5 pieces,
earn BNB. 10% of the remaining pool per day, split among staked sets. Pool
funded manually by the owner from mint revenue; no owner withdraw. Details
in SKILL.md, data in pieces.json.

## Game

Shard Rush: 100 rounds, 4 rotating styles (RUSH / DODGE / CHASE / BLITZ),
collect 5 pieces per round, 3 lives, mouse / touch / WASD. Win by
finishing round 100 ("CURSOR MASTER").
